description: Erection of an outbuilding in rear garden.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Sky Garden Wildflower Blanket System SGWBS01; DWG01; DWG03; Arboricultural Impact Assessment dated July 2025 prepared by GHA Trees Arboricultural Consultancy; Tree Constraints Plan dated July 2025 prepared by GHA Trees Arboricultural Consultancy; Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment ref. GHA/DS/160278:25 dated 14th July 2025 prepared by GHA Trees Arboricultural Consultancy; Biodiversity Net Gain Assessment ref. 32261 dated 8th October 2025 prepared by ACP Consultants Ltd.; DWG02iii; DWG06ii; DWG07ii; Letter tilted "BNG Solution Methodology" dated 10th October 2025 issued by Biodiversity Units UK Ltd.; Letter titled "Letter of reservation" dated 10th October 2025 issued by Biodiversity Units UK Ltd.; Sky Garden Wildflower Blanket System SGWBSS01 Version 1.3; Sky Garden Fire Statement Version 1.1; Sky Garden Green Roof Maintenance Guidelines Version 1.0; DWG04iv; DWG05iv; WBSD01; BNG statutory metrics spreadsheet.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of works on site, tree protection measures shall be installed and working practices adopted in accordance with the document entitled "Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment" dated 14th July 2025 by GHA Trees Arboricultural Consultancy ref. GHA/DS/160278:25.  All trees on the site, or parts of trees grow from adjoining sites, unless shown on the permitted drawings as being removed, shall be retained and protected from damage in accordance with BS5837:2012 and with the approved protection details. The development shall be monitored by the project arboriculturalist in accordance with the approved report.
 
Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan.
Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as Flat A, 186 Goldhurst Terrace, London, NW6 3HN

Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the residential use, adjoining premises, and the area generally in accordance with policy A1 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
